en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Zurara, from Sama’at – similar to it.
Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby,

(The narrator) says: ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the thing which is placed on the road, so the animal passes by, so it panics and fells its rider. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Everything which harms the Muslims by a road, so its perpetrator is responsible for what (harm) it causes’.
